messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: http://spark.rstudio.com/ungp/RFood/
parts:
It looks like you're referencing a variable in server.R that you never define. Perhaps you intended to load the RData file into the R session first?

If it's working locally, try clearing out your Environment (Environment Tab > "Clear", if you're using RStudio) then run it again. I suspect you'll get the same error.

Check out http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#scoping for more details on which variables are available where in Shiny.

Jeff
